name: Library Membership
query:
SELECT
    `tabMembership`.`member_name` as `Member Name:Link/Membership:180`,
    `tabMembership`.`membership_type` as `Membership Type:Date:150`,
    `tabMembership`.`membership_status` as `Membership Status:Data:150`,
    `tabMembership`.`duration_of_membership` as `Duration_of Membership:Data:180`,
    `tabMembership`.`from_date` as `from_date:Date:120`,
    `tabMembership`.`to_date` as `To Date:Date:120`
    FROM    
        `tabMembership`
